questions.q: What did the girl want to buy?
questions.e: In the video: "htela sam da kupim deset ovih velikih ogrlica" — I wanted to buy ten of these big necklaces.

questions.q: How much do ten necklaces come to?
questions.e: In the video: "Deset puta hiljadu petsto, petnaest hiljada" — ten times one thousand five hundred, fifteen thousand.

questions.q: How much are the small necklaces?
questions.e: In the video: "to su male, od 300 dinara" — those are small ones, 300 dinars each.

questions.q: How did the saleswoman first answer the question whether they are open?
o: That they are closed — done for today
That they are open until night
questions.e: In the video: "Ne, nažalost, gotovo je za danas" — no, unfortunately, we are done for today.

questions.q: Ah, *šteta*, htela sam da kupim deset ovih velikih ogrlica.

questions.e: Žuriti — to hurry; žurite — 2nd pers. pl.

questions.q: Ah, šteta, htela sam da kupim deset ovih velikih ___.
questions.e: After the numeral "ten" comes the genitive plural: ogrlica.
Thanks to whom? — the dative: hvala vam.
